bug_report: The heartbeat timer never fires: the firmware always prints 'tick timeout'.

agent.root_cause: The timer was not actually enabled because the code set the URS (Update Request Source) bit instead of the CEN (Counter Enable) bit in TIM2_CR1. Bit 0 is CEN, bit 1 is URS. Setting bit 0 starts the timer.

initial_evidence.uart:
boot ok
tick timeout
init done

evaluation.uart:
boot ok
tick ok
init done
